notes: Revision inspected is a feature branch (fix/issues-23-24-...), not main; the BitRep link-attestation code (app/bitrep_verify, app/evidence/link_attestation.py) exists only there. Re-run P0 against main after merge if the contract boundary should reflect main.

Two disjoint BitRep profiles inside one repo: legacy API (statement_type index.link.v1, subject=claim_id, audience=operator-chosen, vendored verifier, in-memory) vs chain (index-support/1|index-challenge/1, audience index:eip155:..., out-of-process adapter at pinned checkout, content bytes bound). Neither is registered as a shared contract; PROTOCOL.md:274-275 says strings await Governor approval.

chain/PROTOCOL.md:168 says no BitRep source is copied into the Index, but app/bitrep_verify vendors three BitRep modules (BITREP_LINK_ATTESTATION.md:15-22): stale statement. BitRep repo named cogno-us/cognous-evidence-attestation in PROTOCOL.md:164 but cogno-us/bitrep in vendored headers.

BitRep contract doc (VERIFICATION_CONTRACT_V1.md) is referenced but not in this repo, and BITREP_LINK_ATTESTATION.md:3-5 calls cross-component adoption 'proposed pending Governor review'; vendoring pins BitRep code, so any BitRep change is a re-vendor (explicit rule at models.py:3).
Blocked boundary: contract-enforced BitRep issuer validity (no Ed25519 verifier on chain); evidence 'statement' field is only an unverified commitment (PROTOCOL.md:208-213).

F-19 (copied evidence): the label 'F-19' does not appear in this repo. Relevant text, as it bears on the Index/BitRep contract boundary: PROTOCOL.md:77-79 and 156-160 (copies under other IDs remain visible; same content hash is a duplicate signal; differing bytes do not prove independence; signatures/issuer ids do not multiply weight), VALIDATION.md:110 (copied-support test row), BITREP_LINK_ATTESTATION.md:60-66 (independence counts distinct source_identifier; duplicate links/records still add weight, 'known limit'). Boundary consequence: BitRep attests issuer signature only (assurance 'issuer_signature_only', models.py:51), so a relayed/copied genuine statement verifies (PROTOCOL.md:181-183); independence/copy detection lives entirely on the Index side and is a free-text source_identifier heuristic, not an attested field.

Index produces no artifact that any other Cognous component in this repo set consumes; Exchange explicitly does not consume Index/BitRep (reference README.md:66, mapping.md:47). Interface to Index is therefore currently the Link/Evidence JSON + chain events, with no versioned schema matching app models (schema/*.json describe a different legacy shape: source_id/target_id/weight/attestor_id vs claim_id/evidence_id/strength/attested_by).
Legacy services are in-memory, unauthenticated, loopback-only (CHANGELOG.md F5b entry); migration doc says previously stored links are not re-verified (BITREP_LINK_ATTESTATION.md:73).
Test drivers for the chain/BitRep boundary live in cognous-stack-qualification (CROSS_COMPONENT_TESTS.md:3-10); only app unit tests and tests/fixtures/bitrep-verification-v1.json stay here.
